description: Calculate a Da Liu Ren (大六壬) plate for a date-time: day and hour ganzhi, month general (月将, switched at the zhongqi instant), heaven and earth plates, twelve generals, noble person direction, four lessons, three transmissions and lesson pattern. Calculation only, no reading. Source: multifate.com/tools/daliuren.

dateTime.description: Local clock time of the question, ISO without offset, e.g. 2026-10-22T14:30.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of dateTime. It only decides which side of the month-general switch (the zhongqi instant) the clock falls on. Omitted means the clock is UTC+8, the same rule as multifate.com.
